SELECT r.id, r.target_type AS targetType, reporter.name AS reporterName, target_member.name AS targetUserName,
CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'POST' THEN p.content WHEN r.target_type = 'REPLY' THEN reply.content END AS content,
r.reason, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.status
FROM report r
JOIN member reporter ON reporter.id = r.member_id
LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id = r.post_id
LEFT JOIN reply ON reply.id = r.reply_id
LEFT JOIN member target_member ON target_member.id = r.target_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND r.target_type = #{targetType}
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id, r.target_type AS targetType, r.post_id AS postId, r.reply_id AS replyId, r.target_Id AS targetMemberId, reporter.name AS reporterName, target_member.name AS targetUserName,
CASE WHEN r.target_type = 'POST' THEN p.content WHEN r.target_type = 'REPLY' THEN reply.content END AS content,
r.reason, r.content AS reportContent, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.status
FROM report r
JOIN member reporter ON reporter.id = r.member_id
LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id = r.post_id
LEFT JOIN reply ON reply.id = r.reply_id
LEFT JOIN member target_member ON target_member.id = p.member_id
WHERE r.id = #{reportId}
